image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a mature male common iguana (Iguana iguana) perched on a textured rock. The iguana features a prominent orange dewlap, a serrated dorsal crest running down its neck and back, and rough, granular green-grey scales. One forelimb is visible gripping the rock surface.
